relocation_line: I will relocate to Sydney for this role and can start two weeks after an offer.
cover_letter_text:
Hi TTW team,

I graduated in February 2026 with an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, and I'd like to train as a civil drafter. Your North Sydney traineeship comes with three years of on-the-job training and mentoring, so I'm applying.

The course had me designing road geometry, earthworks and stormwater drainage, with the drawings done in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I also lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designed around existing services. Before that, on a community hall renovation in the Philippines, I was the one reading the structural and architectural drawings and checking the work matched them.

I'll move to Sydney for the traineeship and can start two weeks after an offer. I also have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). I'd be glad to talk whenever it suits you.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
